look_here_first: Do not stop at the white petals. Confirm with glaucous foliage plus bud, sepal-horn, and mature capsule armature because Argemone albiflora subsp. texana can look very similar in flower.

lookalikes.differences: White petals and yellow latex overlap strongly with A. albiflora subsp. texana. Compare the often unarmed UPPER leaf blade, ellipsoid-oblong buds, 6–10(–15) mm rounded usually unarmed sepal horns, and widely spaced shorter capsule prickles (4–10[–12] mm). A. aurantiaca has much longer, often branched capsule prickles and orange-red latex; pale A. sanguinea can be mistaken from flowers alone.
